title: Monotone Diameters of Lattice Polytopes
summary: An influential 1989 result of Naddef shows that the diameters of $0/1$-polytopes are at most their dimension. This was extended shortly after by Kleinschmidt and Onn to any lattice polytope in $[0,k]^{d}$, where they showed a bound of at most $dk$. Naddef's argument easily extends to the monotone setting motivated by the simplex method, where one requires paths to increase with respect to a linear objective function.
